desc: The Benelli M2 compatible MLOK handguard is machined from 6063 aluminum. It is 9.375" in length and weighs in at 8.8 ounces fully assembled. The handguard features 38 full size MLOK attachment slots and 9 additional partial MLOK attachment slots. The handguard ships with the receiver and front barrel mount assembled. The handguard will drop right in and no disassembly of the handguard is required. Please note the rail is offered in either a Mil-Spec hard anodize or Elite Blackout Cerakote.
